tasks.title: Revalidate source inventory and observed work
tasks.deliverable: Source-backed walkthroughs of 27 requirements, 96 pain points, 35 opportunities, transcript work groups and current native routines.
tasks.acceptance: Operations and bookkeeper classify each as current, changed, obsolete, process remedy or conditional; preserve source status and gaps.

tasks.title: Validate account interfaces and native feature fit
tasks.deliverable: Per-operation account/region/entitlement matrix, native feature trial, approved test-record catalogue and exact request/response contracts.
tasks.acceptance: Every proposed operation has a supported interface or owned manual fallback; API documentation and successful account trials remain distinct.

tasks.title: Resolve workflow rules and ambiguous transcript fragments
tasks.deliverable: Versioned fields, periods, units, cancellation/travel treatment, mappings and documented unknown fragments.
tasks.acceptance: No garbled figure, undefined date, certificate, contract or report fragment becomes an enabled rule without owner evidence.

tasks.title: Agree access and privacy boundaries
tasks.deliverable: Data classification, role/branch/relationship/field matrix, retention and external service review.
tasks.acceptance: Confidential care/HR/finance, worker contact/home location and representative access have explicit allow/deny cases; jurisdiction obligations receive qualified review.

tasks.title: Measure workload and agree operating targets
tasks.deliverable: Measured volumes, staff handling baseline, peak profile, cost envelope, response coverage and proposed recovery targets.
tasks.acceptance: Owners approve workload, performance/availability targets, RPO/RTO, support responsibility and budget before capacity/price commitments.

tasks.title: Confirm inherited views and scope dispositions
tasks.deliverable: Core20/gated5/later10 scope, all portal proposals and retained approved Mapbox views; process-only items remain assigned.
tasks.acceptance: L01 maps/privacy are retained; discussed P01/P02 features are not assumed approved; optional ETA and new products remain explicitly gated.

tasks.title: Approve architecture decisions and integration ownership
tasks.deliverable: Modular application, authority boundaries, process topology and architecture decision records with open alternatives.
tasks.acceptance: Architecture is conditional where decisions remain open; custom domain owns execution and no external workflow platform is required.

tasks.title: Design database and versioned command contracts
tasks.deliverable: Scoped schema, indexes, composite constraints, state transitions, API schemas and compatibility policy.
tasks.acceptance: Cases, source versions, immutable approvals, actions, attempts, receipts and mandatory dependencies are distinct; command field whitelists reject arbitrary native writes.

tasks.title: Complete threat model and ASVS applicability
tasks.deliverable: Trust-boundary review, attack/abuse cases and disposition of the pinned ASVS L1/L2 controls plus selected L3 checks.
tasks.acceptance: Each control has applicability/rationale, implementation owner and evidence criteria; unresolved critical threat paths block sensitive data activation.

tasks.title: Specify source and vendor adapter contracts
tasks.deliverable: Typed field sets, pagination types, canonical timestamps, source completeness, correlation and error/retry classification.
tasks.acceptance: No assumed general webhook, SMS API, payroll endpoint or native compare-and-swap; unsupported steps have named checked handoffs.

tasks.title: Implement production identity and revocable sessions
tasks.deliverable: Approved staff OIDC/MFA integration and server sessions, recovery/offboarding and service identities; remove production env-password authentication.
tasks.acceptance: Issuer/audience/state/nonce/PKCE, session rotation, revocation, idle/absolute limits and fresh authentication rules pass; portal identity is separately approved.

tasks.title: Enforce object field and branch authorization
tasks.deliverable: Deny-by-default capabilities, scoped memberships, relationship policies and database row policies.
tasks.acceptance: Every query, mutation, export, file and job resolves scope server-side; pooled DB connections cannot inherit another request scope; service jobs cannot bypass case approval.

tasks.title: Harden API browser and command boundaries
tasks.deliverable: Schema validation, CSRF tokens, trusted origin/proxy handling, CORS, secure cookies, CSP and field whitelists.
tasks.acceptance: Cross-site mutation, spoofed proxy headers, unknown fields/roles, unsafe rendering, parameter injection and sensitive response caching fail securely.

tasks.title: Protect uploads OCR and remote downloads
tasks.deliverable: Private quarantined evidence, allowlisted formats, malware scanning, isolated bounded OCR and destination-restricted download validation.
tasks.acceptance: Malicious/oversized files, HTML/SVG execution, archive bombs, expired links, SSRF/private addresses and unsafe redirects cannot reach native writes or privileged networks.

tasks.title: Implement audit privacy and retention controls
tasks.deliverable: Server-derived actors, protected audit events, redacted telemetry, retention/hold/delete/export workflows and tamper-evidence policy.
tasks.acceptance: PII/tokens do not leak to logs; app roles cannot edit approvals/audit; retention respects holds and encrypted backup expiry; DB-admin tampering remains documented residual risk.

tasks.title: Isolate credentials keys and encrypted transport
tasks.deliverable: Environment-separated secret storage, runtime/DB roles, TLS verification, encryption keys and rotation/revocation procedures.
tasks.acceptance: No connector secret reaches bundles/logs; runtime cannot migrate/administer the DB; invalid TLS and absent production storage fail closed.

tasks.title: Add supply chain and pipeline protections
tasks.deliverable: Locked dependencies, pinned tooling/actions, SBOM, secret/SAST/dependency/container scanning and restricted deployment identity.
tasks.acceptance: Untrusted PRs receive no production secrets; exploitable unresolved critical/high issues block release; exceptions require owned evidence and expiry.

tasks.title: Apply abuse rate and spend limits
tasks.deliverable: Per-actor/IP/connector limits, source admission caps, OCR concurrency and vendor request budgets.
tasks.acceptance: Public intake/auth/API abuse is bounded without revealing account existence or starving urgent work; 429 and budget exhaustion remain observable.

tasks.title: Build normalized scoped storage
tasks.deliverable: New numbered migrations for scoped records and job integration; no edits to applied 001-003 migrations.
tasks.acceptance: Composite foreign keys, unique replay/action keys, least-privilege access and optimistic revisions are enforced in real PostgreSQL tests.

tasks.title: Migrate retained legacy records deliberately
tasks.deliverable: Inventory/export, versioned transformer, evidence hashes, dry-run diff and controlled writer/cursor cutover.
tasks.acceptance: After approved privacy/source scope and accepted identity/storage controls, isolated import reconciles retained counts/hashes; pending external work is held. No implicit store migration or normal-user exposure before the separate pilot security gate.

tasks.title: Integrate a mature durable job component
tasks.deliverable: Selected job library, separate worker process, leases, worker fencing and shutdown/drain support.
tasks.acceptance: Job claims survive restart and contention; expired leases cannot create a second native dispatch; queue tables do not replace case history.

tasks.title: Implement versioned approvals and transactional outbox
tasks.deliverable: Typed commands, source/policy/native snapshots, approval records and atomic business event/outbox creation.
tasks.acceptance: Changed evidence invalidates approval; every external path checks the accepted case/opportunity, operation, account, fields and guard/policy version manifest. A legacy route or worker cannot bypass a held workflow by invoking an accepted raw operation.

tasks.title: Implement aggregate completion and uncertain outcome recovery
tasks.deliverable: Parent case dependencies, per-action attempts/receipts and operator reconciliation tools.
tasks.acceptance: Dispatch is persisted before I/O; timeout is not blindly retried; native success does not close unfinished financial/travel/communication actions.

tasks.title: Implement reliable schedules and deadlines
tasks.deliverable: Scoped schedule versions, explicit timezone/period anchors, missed-slot policy, deduplicated overdue events and outbox alerts.
tasks.acceptance: DST, repeated ticks and extended outages do not skip or duplicate approved periods; urgent safety work retains human fallback.

tasks.title: Harden the ShiftCare connector
tasks.deliverable: Account-scoped clients, response schema checks, bounded paging/cursors, freshness receipts, throttling and normalized error classes.
tasks.acceptance: Partial reads cannot become complete reports; retries honor vendor budgets; cross-account IDs/credentials and unsafe remote paths are rejected.

tasks.title: Harden Graph ingestion and attachment provenance
tasks.deliverable: Approved mailbox/folders, immutable IDs, atomic delta advancement and recoverable source import.
tasks.acceptance: Expired cursors, duplicate/out-of-order notifications and interrupted attachment imports recover without lost or repeated business actions.

tasks.title: Accept existing reviewed native adapters
tasks.deliverable: Per-operation whitelist and account trial receipts for basic people, supported documents and guarded occurrence changes.
tasks.acceptance: Real field formats, permissions, state locks, role/invitation behaviour and read-back pass. Raw operation acceptance does not enable a held case type; the release manifest also binds its approved workflow guards and scope.

tasks.title: Extend the shared office workspace
tasks.deliverable: Authenticated queues, original evidence, exact proposed fields, missing steps, due work and reconciliation controls.
tasks.acceptance: Production exposes only accepted routes; unaccepted portal/demo persona controls are disabled before the first real-data pilot. Demo records never become live inputs; server scope and business completion remain authoritative.

tasks.title: Retain approved maps and scope inherited portal access
tasks.deliverable: Office/worker/client map projections and accepted own-service read/request paths; explicit disposition of discussed portal functions.
tasks.acceptance: User-approved L01 remains traced; permitted views show scoped bookings without worker home coordinates/contact leakage; unaccepted portal slices stay disabled in production.

tasks.title: Design reproducible CI and release artifacts
tasks.deliverable: Reviewed version-controlled baseline including accepted currently untracked prototype sources, then future pipeline for reproducible build/test/scan, artifact digest, compatibility manifest and protected promotion.
tasks.acceptance: Build once/promote the same artifact; source/version/deploy identity is recorded; no staging shortcut supplies production credentials.

tasks.title: Prepare isolated hosting and environment contracts
tasks.deliverable: Approved hosting/region, dev/staging/production isolation, persistent API/worker, private DB/evidence and deployment identity.
tasks.acceptance: Host supports durable workers and accepted restore/export; plan costs and data processing are approved; no endless worker is placed in an ephemeral function.

tasks.title: Instrument monitoring alerts and support runbooks
tasks.deliverable: Redacted metrics/traces, source freshness/queue/reconciliation alerts and a tested escalation route.
tasks.acceptance: Stopped worker, stale inbox, queue delay, unknown writes and failed backup alert the named role without exposing care data.

tasks.title: Configure and verify baseline backup recovery
tasks.deliverable: Encrypted DB point-in-time recovery plus consistent versioned evidence/key backup and controlled restore access.
tasks.acceptance: A synthetic/pre-cutover restore recovers records/files and preserves the native-write quarantine procedure within approved RPO/RTO; actual legacy export is backed up before cutover.

tasks.title: Rehearse migration rollback and recovery
tasks.deliverable: Staging rehearsal with migration rollback, worker drain, restored outbox quarantine and native-side reconciliation.
tasks.acceptance: Restore holds normal traffic and native dispatch until current identities/grants, privacy deletions/holds and post-checkpoint native effects are reconciled; old/new reader compatibility and evidence hashes are verified before pilot.

tasks.title: Build isolated domain and security test harnesses
tasks.deliverable: Deterministic fixtures/fake clock/connector fault injection, real PostgreSQL integration and authorized account-trial procedures.
tasks.acceptance: Tests distinguish mocks, provider contracts, real account evidence and human UAT; no fictional receipt is presented as a live success.

tasks.title: Run operation-specific account acceptance
tasks.deliverable: Accepted sandbox/designated records, permission/field tests and redacted evidence by operation.
tasks.acceptance: Every enabled write has a successful authorized trial and independent read-back; only accepted methods/fields enter the release manifest.

tasks.title: Record deferred and native scope decisions
tasks.deliverable: Named native/manual/later dispositions for all 10 deferred opportunities and unapproved T/B proposals.
tasks.acceptance: No source requirement disappears and no later item silently becomes a promised automatic workflow.

tasks.title: Assign process remedies training and handover ownership
tasks.deliverable: Owned existing-tool checklists for procedures, phone/audio/access, groups, offboarding, recruitment and supplier work.
tasks.acceptance: Actual administrators/trainers verify outcomes and readiness; the application does not invent staffing capacity or add ATS/LMS/marketing modules.

tasks.title: Service area screening
tasks.deliverable: Apply the approved coverage list before full intake and automatically route uncertain areas. Existing foundation: Public intake screening and W01 already exist. Remaining: Approve the list and routing rules; retain uncertainty rather than rejecting negotiable areas.
tasks.acceptance: Covered, uncertain and unconfigured postcodes produce the correct recorded outcome.

tasks.title: Centralized enquiry collection
tasks.deliverable: Collect website and authorized mailbox sources, preserve originals and deduplicate enquiries. Existing foundation: Shared intake, Graph polling, immutable message IDs and attachment import exist. Remaining: Test actual mailbox notifications, expired cursors, folder scope, attachments and source replay.
tasks.acceptance: Repeated or changed sources create the correct case/version without duplicate enquiries.

tasks.title: Enquiry ownership and prioritization
tasks.deliverable: Assign configured owners and deadlines, detect overdue requests and suggest urgency and routing. Existing foundation: W02 classification, real-owner validation and deadline marking exist. Remaining: Add approved assignment/escalation rules and notification outcomes; current classification is a suggestion.
tasks.acceptance: Each request has one accountable next action; missed deadlines remain visible and owned.

tasks.title: Missing information detection
tasks.deliverable: Run deterministic required-field, attachment and format checks and prepare missing-information tasks. Existing foundation: Intake rules, original evidence, PDF/OCR and missing-field checks exist. Remaining: Approve required fields and test representative forms. F applies to checking, not obtaining truthful answers.
tasks.acceptance: Incomplete, unsupported and ambiguous sources are flagged without invented values.

tasks.title: Participant onboarding and profile updates
tasks.deliverable: Extract evidenced draft fields, show duplicate candidates and execute approved basic participant changes with read-back. Existing foundation: W03 extraction, person mapping, gated create/update and read-back exist. Remaining: Validate native intake feature fit, actual forms, mapped fields and account writes; preserve prospects until activation is approved.
tasks.acceptance: The source and exact approved fields link to one verified native identity; replay creates no duplicate.

tasks.title: Worker onboarding coordination
tasks.deliverable: Prepare worker fields, execute reviewed basic staff changes and track screening/access/payroll handoffs. Existing foundation: W04 staff adapters and a separate payroll checkpoint exist. Remaining: Test role/invitation behaviour and readiness checks. A recorded onboarding status does not itself establish sign-in permissions.
tasks.acceptance: Approved basic staff data is verified and incomplete HR/payroll steps prevent readiness claims.

tasks.title: Client stages and agreed service details
tasks.deliverable: Track reviewed stage transitions and source-linked service hours/effective changes. Existing foundation: New client mapping defaults to prospect; intake references exist. Remaining: Extend the mapping whitelist for explicit stage transitions; define which native record owns agreed hours rather than creating a second editable agreement.
tasks.acceptance: Only an approved transition changes the native stage; hours retain their authoritative source.

tasks.title: Correspondence preparation
tasks.deliverable: Prepare approved templates, validate recipients/context/attachments and record the communication handoff. Existing foundation: W13 provides owned native handoffs, not automatic outgoing delivery. Remaining: Implement reusable templates and checks. Do not depend on an unverified ShiftCare SMS/chat send API.
tasks.acceptance: A complete reviewed message reaches an owned handoff; no task is labelled as a delivered message.

tasks.title: Communication tracking and history
tasks.deliverable: Link supported communication references and distinguish dispatch, failure, response and checked native history. Existing foundation: W13 requires an actual communication reference; current Graph access is read-only Inbox ingestion. Remaining: Agree channel coverage and add permitted Sent Items/failure evidence. A Graph 202 response is not delivery proof; universal cross-channel read receipts are not promised.
tasks.acceptance: Each status is backed by its own evidence, with unknown outcomes and failed delivery kept open.

tasks.title: Booking preparation and availability checks
tasks.deliverable: Prepare one-off booking drafts and check dates, times, roster overlap, leave and available patterns. Existing foundation: W08 checks existing occurrences; the current adapter has no new-booking create operation. Remaining: Add a whitelisted one-off create adapter and explicit native IDs/defaults if API creation is included. Availability patterns need date expansion; free time is not willingness.
tasks.acceptance: A reviewed one-off arrangement has a verified native result or an explicit native creation handoff.

tasks.title: Booking change scope and verification
tasks.deliverable: Preview change scope and verify a supported saved occurrence against approved fields. Existing foundation: Current snapshot, overlap and single-client/single-worker change/read-back controls exist. Remaining: Keep initial writes to accepted occurrence scope. Series operations are published but not implemented in the existing adapter.
tasks.acceptance: Only the approved scope changes; native mismatch, stale data and locks leave an owned exception.

tasks.title: Travel checking and stale value detection
tasks.deliverable: Calculate route estimates from verified inputs and automatically flag stale or infeasible travel. Existing foundation: Browser travel checking and route utilities exist. Remaining: Move dependency fingerprints/checks to shared server records. F covers estimates and stale-value checks, not mileage entitlement.
tasks.acceptance: Changes to worker, address or preceding visit invalidate the estimate; no estimate becomes actual mileage.

tasks.title: Shift instruction maintenance
tasks.deliverable: Find missing instructions and apply an approved version to explicitly selected native bookings. Existing foundation: Prototype instruction examples exist; the production shift adapter only writes assignment/times. Remaining: Add a description-only adapter, version/hash checks and read-back. Validate series behaviour and locked/cancelled records before bulk changes.
tasks.acceptance: Selected editable bookings match the approved instructions without changing unrelated fields.

tasks.title: Participant confirmation monitoring
tasks.deliverable: Ingest native reminder replies, match exact occurrences and route confirmation/change/cancellation exceptions. Existing foundation: W02 reply candidates and W06 reviewed routing exist. Remaining: Test actual notification formats, mailbox routing, quoted replies and occurrence matching; add event reads if needed.
tasks.acceptance: A clear reply routes once; ambiguous replies and silence never trigger automatic cancellation.

tasks.title: Complete cancellation handling
tasks.deliverable: Execute reviewed cancellation steps with separate verified travel, charge and communication outcomes. Existing foundation: W07 persists dispatch and verifies cancellation, but performs no travel/mileage cleanup. Remaining: Add verified cleanup before cancellation where required. Cancelled shifts restrict later edits. Model cleanup-success/cancel-failure and block closure until required handoffs finish.
tasks.acceptance: No untravelled charge remains incorrectly applied; partial or unknown outcomes stay open without duplicate dispatch.

tasks.title: Absence and replacement cover coordination
tasks.deliverable: List disrupted services, prepare candidates, track offers/acceptance and each participant outcome. Existing foundation: W08 guards one-worker assignment; native matching/offers remain handoffs. Remaining: Add shared cover-case dependencies and affected-service tracking. Keep offer and acceptance native until their adapters are accepted.
tasks.acceptance: Each affected service has a verified arrangement or owned no-cover outcome, with required communication.

tasks.title: Factual absence histories
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Defer dedicated HR history until core absence coordination is accepted; define restricted access and corrections.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Management resolves disputed facts and all employment interpretation.

tasks.title: Document matching and filing
tasks.deliverable: Match reviewed originals and upload supported client documents with metadata and independent verification. Existing foundation: Document upload, metadata checks and native-byte hashing exist for client PDF/text files. Remaining: Validate actual document types, field/date formats and download hosts. Do not claim the adapter supports every staff file or image.
tasks.acceptance: The correct original is verified under the correct native person, category and access setting.

tasks.title: Document completeness and attachment checks
tasks.deliverable: Compare configured required documents/attachments with complete available metadata and create specific exceptions. Existing foundation: Evidence files, document reads and attachment checks exist. Remaining: Add requirement matrices and complete-scope results. F covers presence/metadata checks, not proof that a valid agreement exists or is absent everywhere.
tasks.acceptance: Missing, present and unreadable/unknown evidence remain distinct and generate the right follow-up.

tasks.title: Document date and expiry correction
tasks.deliverable: Prepare reviewed date/expiry corrections and verify accepted native metadata updates. Existing foundation: Client metadata and staff qualification expiry adapters exist. Remaining: Validate date/null/no-expiration response semantics. General staff-file expiry correction is not implemented in the current adapter.
tasks.acceptance: Only evidence-backed corrections suppress false alerts; genuine expiries remain visible.

tasks.title: Renewal and coordinator follow up
tasks.deliverable: Detect genuine due/missing evidence, schedule owned renewal/coordinator tasks and retain responses. Existing foundation: W12 scoped staff collection and review schedules exist. Remaining: Reuse native reminder sending, repair metadata first, avoid duplicate alerts and implement missed-run recovery and escalation.
tasks.acceptance: A due item creates one owned follow-up, remains open until checked and survives a missed schedule.

tasks.title: Invoice preparation checks
tasks.deliverable: Prepare period billing exceptions from actual attendance, notes and native invoiceable/invoice data. Existing foundation: W10 collects visit/invoice evidence; there is no invoiceable-items cursor adapter yet. Remaining: Add cursor-aware pre-invoice reads and agreed rules/cutoffs. Use native pricing rather than calculating care billing rates in the application.
tasks.acceptance: Complete period evidence produces traceable exceptions; no duplicate invoice/export or false all-clear occurs.

tasks.title: Special billing instructions and prepayments
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Defer live balance integration until authorized Xero access and ID reconciliation are implemented. Do not create another ledger.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Bookkeeper applies balances and approves accounting treatment.

tasks.title: Billing recipient verification
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Defer dedicated cross-system recipient automation; keep checks in existing onboarding/billing review until account mappings are verified.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Staff verify authority and effective payer changes before updating billing.

tasks.title: Returned invoice resolution
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Defer a dedicated correction/reissue automation; reuse #3/#22 cases and native accounting actions first.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Bookkeeper determines credit, correction or reissue and checks the result.

tasks.title: Payment follow up
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Defer custom collection status until ledger IDs, tokens and reconciliation are accepted; do not treat a ShiftCare balance as verified Xero payment.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Bookkeeper approves disputes, escalation and any collection action.

tasks.title: Pay period and employee checks
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Defer payroll-side automation until the actual vendor/field mappings are known. Inactive ShiftCare access does not establish zero pay.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Payroll confirms final-pay eligibility and the meaning of prior values.

tasks.title: Timesheet hours and mileage reconciliation
tasks.deliverable: Check ShiftCare period completeness, actual hours and mileage units, then compare approved payroll input where available. Existing foundation: W11 and browser payroll review exist; a live payroll-system connector is not implemented. Remaining: First deliver source checks and reviewed handoff. Add two-sided comparison only against the real export/API; do not claim automated payroll reconciliation without it.
tasks.acceptance: Missing timesheets never become zero pay; approved quantities and units trace to their source and period.

tasks.title: Payroll adjustment tracking
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Keep calculations and native entry manual initially; support evidence through #28 rather than building an award/payroll engine.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Payroll calculates and approves leave, back pay and travel treatment in the established payroll process.

tasks.title: Payroll completion handoffs
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Retain finalization and money movement in the established platform; a duplicate release workflow adds little benefit and substantial risk.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Authorized payroll staff finalize the run, release payment and deliver payslips in the payroll platform.

tasks.title: Visit record and care exceptions
tasks.deliverable: Detect factual missing/invalid attendance or notes, duration differences and source-defined significant events. Existing foundation: W09 visit collection and factual exception preparation exist. Remaining: Validate complete periods, staff-specific evidence and restricted access; task-specific completion comparisons need accepted source fields.
tasks.acceptance: A factual exception cites its original record and owner without making a clinical or misconduct conclusion.

tasks.title: Feedback complaint and safety follow through
tasks.deliverable: Schedule agreed feedback, retain authorized responses and track complaint/safety callbacks and corrective follow-up. Existing foundation: W09/W13 cases and handoffs provide a foundation; a feedback-specific shared case is additional work. Remaining: Add restricted case fields, owners, follow-up schedule and explicit urgent escalation; avoid automatic clinical triage.
tasks.acceptance: Every response/action has an accountable outcome; restricted information stays within permitted access.

tasks.title: Task completion handovers and escalation
tasks.deliverable: Run configured assignment, deadline, handover and required-step completion checks automatically. Existing foundation: Owners, deadlines, dispatch records and individual follow-up jobs exist. Remaining: Add parent-case dependencies, external notification outcomes and catch-up. Current native jobs can complete before their separate communication follow-up.
tasks.acceptance: A parent case cannot close while any mandatory child outcome remains incomplete or uncertain.

tasks.title: Operational outcome reporting
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Keep baseline pilot measures in core instrumentation; defer a dedicated reporting workflow until daily work is stable. No forecast model is proposed.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Management interprets staffing, cost and demand implications.

tasks.title: Arrival visibility if the remaining gap is confirmed
tasks.deliverable: Disposition and owned native/manual process; implementation requires a separately approved change. Defer optional arrival work pending native-feature fit and device/privacy trials; continuous background tracking is not established.
tasks.acceptance: Review the deferral/native boundary and actual owner; no automated completion claim. Approve access/consent and validate actual devices and withdrawal behaviour.

tasks.title: Accept the first 10 end to end
tasks.deliverable: Functional/source/replay/authorization UAT receipts for first core batch.
tasks.acceptance: All first-core scopes pass their acceptance conditions; every unautomated/native step is labelled and owned.

tasks.title: Complete release security and fault acceptance
tasks.deliverable: Current-release ASVS evidence, abuse/fault/security testing and approved capacity results.
tasks.acceptance: No unresolved exploitable critical/high issue; ASVS applicability/evidence and residual risks reviewed; rerun affected tests for later feature waves.

tasks.title: Run a restricted read-only pilot
tasks.deliverable: Approved source subset, shadow findings, manual comparison and operational feedback.
tasks.acceptance: Current-release security, privacy/access, accepted route scope, source completeness and support gates pass before real data; no native write is enabled by a shadow result.

tasks.title: Activate accepted supervised core writes
tasks.deliverable: Versioned operation enablement manifest and witnessed first actions.
tasks.acceptance: Only accepted fields/operations are enabled; approvals, read-back, support and stop/reconciliation controls work; no bulk backfill auto-dispatch.

tasks.title: Accept all 20 core workflows
tasks.deliverable: Core20 functional, security, performance and native-handoff evidence including inherited views.
tasks.acceptance: Exactly 20 scoped opportunities meet acceptance; payroll-side comparison is not claimed without its real source; no duplicated native reminders/exports.

tasks.title: Expand to accepted core20 operation
tasks.deliverable: Core20 release manifest, operating baselines and support handover.
tasks.acceptance: Actual automation/manual boundaries are accepted; source freshness, overdue cases, errors and staff effort are reviewed against baseline.

tasks.title: Accept the five gated additions
tasks.deliverable: Per-addition account/data/policy receipts and current regression/security results.
tasks.acceptance: Each gate has evidence; cancellation tests include cleanup-success/cancel-failure, uncertain outcomes and failed communication; unavailable additions remain held.

tasks.title: Reach the accepted target25 scope
tasks.deliverable: Target25 scope manifest and actual completion evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Claim 25 only after all five gates pass; specific additions may be promoted earlier through the same tested release controls.

tasks.title: Accept branch expansion
tasks.deliverable: Approved branch/account/organization mappings and branch-specific deployment/configuration receipts.
tasks.acceptance: Cross-branch negative tests, pooled scope isolation, per-account budgets and schedule/backlog checks pass before another branch is enabled.

tasks.title: Operate maintain and review the service
tasks.deliverable: Runbook ownership, patch/dependency/vendor review calendar, access/secret review and recovery drills.
tasks.acceptance: Support cover and escalation are real; key rotation, restores, incident learning and costs are reviewed on approved recurring cadence.

tests.scenario: Walkthrough source-linked cases and disputed/date/unit fragments; verify current process and written decisions.
tests.expected_result: Every entry has a confirmed disposition or explicit owned gate; no invented rule.

tests.scenario: Reject wrong issuer/audience/state/nonce, missing MFA policy, replayed callback and expired/revoked/disabled sessions; test recovery and offboarding.
tests.expected_result: Identity is server-derived and revoked access fails across API/worker/portal.

tests.scenario: Attempt every action/file/export by other branch/org/person/role and worker service identity; reuse pooled connections and guessed IDs.
tests.expected_result: Deny by default with no field/record leakage; valid scope works.

tests.scenario: Exercise CSRF missing/bad tokens, absent/foreign origins, CORS, GET mutation attempts, host/proxy spoofing and secure cookie flags.
tests.expected_result: Unsafe requests fail; proxy configuration cannot downgrade session security.

tests.scenario: Use SQL/JSON/path/header payloads, overflows, unexpected native fields, role escalation, hostile CSV cells and invalid money/time units.
tests.expected_result: Typed allowed fields and canonical units survive; dangerous input has no effect.

tests.scenario: Render hostile mail, notes, filenames and template text; test CSP, external image/URL handling and navigation.
tests.expected_result: No script execution, unsafe protocol or disclosure; map assets still work under the accepted CSP.

tests.scenario: Import malformed/mislabeled/oversized PDF/images, malware fixtures, archive bombs, parser failures and interrupted uploads.
tests.expected_result: Files stay quarantined or rejected; OCR has CPU/memory/time bounds and no privileged execution.

tests.scenario: Try private IPv4/IPv6, localhost, metadata IPs, userinfo, redirects, DNS rebinding, unexpected ports/hosts and expired signed URLs.
tests.expected_result: Only accepted destinations are fetched within strict response limits; unsafe files never dispatch.

tests.scenario: Inspect builds/logs/errors/backups; revoke/rotate a connector key and encryption access; simulate missing/invalid TLS/production storage.
tests.expected_result: No secret/PII exposure; runtime fails closed and revocation/restore access is verified.

tests.scenario: Attempt to alter audit/approval actors, edit history, omit receipts and leak private data through telemetry; verify protected evidence exports.
tests.expected_result: Tampering is denied/detectable for app roles; actual approver and native attribution remain distinct.

risks.title: Account/session compromise
risks.cause: Environment password staff auth or non-revocable cookies expose sensitive operations.
risks.planned_mitigation: Use accepted OIDC/MFA, revocable server sessions, throttling and recovery/offboarding.
risks.residual_risk: IdP compromise and session theft remain possible; exercise revocation and fresh authentication.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Cross-person or branch disclosure
risks.cause: ID guessing or incomplete field/branch checks expose care, HR, payroll or evidence.
risks.planned_mitigation: Deny-by-default relationship/field permissions, scoped FKs/RLS and server-side projections.
risks.residual_risk: Misconfigured memberships or privileged DB roles can bypass intent; review and negative-test all paths.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Broad native service credentials
risks.cause: A native key may act with account-owner scope and native attribution cannot identify the actual approver.
risks.planned_mitigation: Use narrow native credentials where supported, application operation allowlists, scoped workers and own actor/approval audit.
risks.residual_risk: Vendor credential scope/attribution limitations remain; native-owner activity needs reconciliation.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: CSRF and trusted-header confusion
risks.cause: Origin checks or forwarded headers alone can authorize an unsafe browser mutation.
risks.planned_mitigation: CSRF token, explicit origin rules, trusted proxy configuration and secure host cookies.
risks.residual_risk: Browser compromise still defeats same-session protection; use MFA/re-auth and field authorization.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Stored XSS and unsafe mail rendering
risks.cause: Mail, notes, templates or filenames execute active content or load tracking resources.
risks.planned_mitigation: Context encoding, safe text/sanitization, CSP and blocked unapproved remote content.
risks.residual_risk: Sanitizer/browser defects remain; patch and regression-test rendering.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: SSRF through native download links
risks.cause: A signed URL or redirect points at metadata/private networks or an unapproved host.
risks.planned_mitigation: Validate exact destination, protocol, port, DNS/IP ranges and expiry; block redirects and limit bytes/egress.
risks.residual_risk: DNS/storage-provider changes can invalidate allowlists; fail closed and review changes.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Malicious evidence or OCR exhaustion
risks.cause: Files exploit parsers or exhaust memory/CPU and block urgent work.
risks.planned_mitigation: Quarantine/scan, allowlisted MIME signatures, isolated bounded parser jobs and separate concurrency.
risks.residual_risk: Scanner/parser bypasses remain; manual unsupported-file handling and rapid patching.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Secret or private payload leakage
risks.cause: Tokens/keys or care data appear in builds, telemetry, errors or backup access.
risks.planned_mitigation: Server secret store, encryption/TLS, redaction, environment isolation and rotation drills.
risks.residual_risk: Privileged operator/provider access remains; minimize data and audit privileged access.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Duplicate and out-of-order work
risks.cause: Replay or concurrent collection creates duplicate cases, people or actions.
risks.planned_mitigation: Stable source/version keys, unique dispatch identities, transactional outbox and worker fencing.
risks.residual_risk: External systems without idempotency still need reconciliation and ambiguous-match review.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Unknown remote write outcome
risks.cause: A remote write succeeds while response/local receipt is lost and retry repeats it.
risks.planned_mitigation: Persist dispatch, mark uncertainty, reconcile before resend, preserve external evidence.
risks.residual_risk: Eventual consistency may prevent automatic proof; an owned manual exception remains.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Stale approval and concurrent native edit
risks.cause: A native user or another integration changes the record after review/preflight.
risks.planned_mitigation: Bind source/policy/fields, per-target lock, fresh preflight and native version condition where supported.
risks.residual_risk: Without vendor compare-and-swap the race cannot be eliminated; detect/reconcile mismatches.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Partial cancellation and travel charges
risks.cause: Travel cleanup is absent or happens after the native cancellation locks edits.
risks.planned_mitigation: Approve and verify required cleanup first, then cancel/read back; track every action and communication dependency.
risks.residual_risk: A failed later step leaves real partial changes; bookkeeper/office recovery is required.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Recurring/group blast radius
risks.cause: A single write changes more occurrences/people or financial scope than approved.
risks.planned_mitigation: Explicit occurrence list/window preview, accepted adapters and initial bounds; gate groups/series.
risks.residual_risk: Native series expansion/state differences need per-account evidence; unsupported cases stay native.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Incorrect finance or payroll interpretation
risks.cause: Missing source data becomes zero pay; estimates/units/credits are treated as actuals.
risks.planned_mitigation: Separate units and source states, native pricing/ledger/export, approved mappings and human financial treatment.
risks.residual_risk: The application cannot validate unprovided payroll rules or all ledger outcomes.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: False notification success or wrong recipient
risks.cause: Created task/sent response is mistaken for receipt or an update goes to the wrong person.
risks.planned_mitigation: Verify recipient and track dispatch/failure/response/acknowledgement separately; native checked handoffs.
risks.residual_risk: Some channels do not provide delivery/read proof; retain unknown states and human follow-up.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Incomplete collection reported as all-clear
risks.cause: Pagination caps, wrong filters or an unavailable source hide missing evidence.
risks.planned_mitigation: Complete-scope receipts, explicit empty/partial/stale states and cursor-aware adapters.
risks.residual_risk: Vendor filtering/schema changes require contract monitoring and sampled native comparison.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Timezone cutoff or missed review
risks.cause: DST/restarts/fortnight anchors create skipped or duplicated financial periods.
risks.planned_mitigation: IANA zones, explicit UTC instants/calendar periods, schedule versions and bounded slot catch-up.
risks.residual_risk: Wrong owner-approved calendar still produces wrong periods; business review remains required.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Wrong identity consent or signature
risks.cause: Duplicate candidate matching or extraction updates the wrong person or accepts invalid paperwork.
risks.planned_mitigation: Evidence-based review, explicit native IDs and conservative matching/signature checks.
risks.residual_risk: Forgery or source errors may need human investigation; do not automate authenticity claims.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Worker status mistaken for access or readiness
risks.cause: Native onboarding_status is treated as permission revocation or employment approval.
risks.planned_mitigation: Verify role/invitation/access semantics and separate readiness/HR/payroll checks.
risks.residual_risk: Native status and sign-in behaviour can diverge; account admin verifies actual access.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Over-retention or unapproved processing
risks.cause: Care/HR data is copied broadly or sent to maps/AI/support without approved purpose.
risks.planned_mitigation: Minimize evidence, approve processors/regions/retention/holds and default optional AI/ETA off.
risks.residual_risk: Legal/contract interpretation and provider access remain owner/adviser responsibilities.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Untrusted content controls extraction or tools
risks.cause: Email/document prompts or forged fields become authority for tool execution.
risks.planned_mitigation: Treat content as data; bounded extraction, schema/evidence validation and no privileged tools or secrets in extraction workers.
risks.residual_risk: Extraction may be incorrect; human approval and deterministic command checks remain required.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Supply chain or CI compromise
risks.cause: Untrusted dependency/build/PR gains deploy or runtime secrets.
risks.planned_mitigation: Pinned inputs, lockfile/SBOM/scans, protected promotion and separate least-privilege deploy identity.
risks.residual_risk: Zero-days and platform compromise remain; patch response and artifact provenance are essential.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Legacy loss or unsafe migration replay
risks.cause: Retained JSON/Redis/file history is lost or old approved/in-flight work auto-runs after cutover.
risks.planned_mitigation: Inventory retained data, backup, hashes/counts, stop old writers and import pending work into reconciliation hold.
risks.residual_risk: Previously pruned history cannot be reconstructed automatically; owner accepts known gaps.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Restore repeats remote effects
risks.cause: Restoring DB/outbox to an earlier checkpoint loses evidence of a later native write.
risks.planned_mitigation: Restore into write quarantine, recover external/audit evidence and reconcile native targets before re-enabling dispatch.
risks.residual_risk: External state is not rolled back with the database; some actions require manual investigation.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Evidence and DB drift
risks.cause: A file exists without metadata or a restored record points at absent/changed bytes.
risks.planned_mitigation: Quarantine/finalization states, checksums, object versions, orphan handling and consistent restore manifests.
risks.residual_risk: Storage outage/version retention gaps can delay evidence; keep cases blocked.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Outage throttling and starvation
risks.cause: Vendor downtime or OCR backlog delays urgent work and exhausts request/spend budgets.
risks.planned_mitigation: Bounded queues, retry budgets/jitter/Retry-After, per-account limits and separate urgent/OCR work classes.
risks.residual_risk: Vendor outages cannot be eliminated; native/manual fallback and support coverage remain necessary.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Missing or misleading audit/alerts
risks.cause: Native success or operational failure is invisible, or logs reveal confidential data.
risks.planned_mitigation: Protected audit, source/queue/reconciliation metrics and exercised redacted alert routing.
risks.residual_risk: App audit is not tamper-proof against all admins; separate audit access/retention and review.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Portal or location disclosure
risks.cause: Demo identities, stale assignment, representative access or route data expose another person/worker home.
risks.planned_mitigation: Verified relationship mapping, field projections, no raw worker-home sharing, no API cache and explicit optional ETA consent/freshness.
risks.residual_risk: Device/location accuracy and representative authority require actual acceptance.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: New owner dependency and unstaffed support
risks.cause: Only one developer/admin understands jobs, exceptions or incident response.
risks.planned_mitigation: Named maintainer/backup, runbooks, training, handovers, access review and funded support.
risks.residual_risk: Staff availability and budget can still constrain response.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Urgent care issue waits for automation
risks.cause: Staff rely on a scheduled alert while a safety concern or missed service needs immediate action.
risks.planned_mitigation: Keep and rehearse the existing urgent incident/contact process and actual duty cover.
risks.residual_risk: Human response/capacity remains essential; the system is not an emergency service.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Unmeasured scale or cost commitment
risks.cause: Volumes and support are guessed, leading to overloaded or unaffordable operation.
risks.planned_mitigation: Measure profile/baseline, test load/backlog and approve budget/thresholds before commitments.
risks.residual_risk: Future branches and vendor pricing may change the operating envelope.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Rollback mistaken for native undo
risks.cause: An old DB/code version is restored after native effects, or unsafe compensating writes are attempted.
risks.planned_mitigation: Drain/hold uncertain work, use compatible schema and reconcile native effects with explicit review.
risks.residual_risk: Some native effects cannot be reversed safely; manual correction can be required.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Environment and proxy misconfiguration
risks.cause: Staging uses production credentials or insecure TLS/cookies/private DB ports are exposed.
risks.planned_mitigation: Separate accounts/storage/keys, trusted ingress, egress restrictions and production fail-closed config validation.
risks.residual_risk: Hosting/provider mistakes remain; continuously verify environment identity and access.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Wrong account or organization routing
risks.cause: A valid person ID exists in another account and the wrong connector is selected.
risks.planned_mitigation: Composite scoped identity links, explicit branch/account mappings and immutable service context.
risks.residual_risk: Incorrect approved mapping can still route wrong; business/account acceptance is mandatory.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Spreadsheet formula injection
risks.cause: Exported free-text starts spreadsheet commands when staff open a CSV.
risks.planned_mitigation: Escape dangerous cells in approved export encoding and test target spreadsheet handling.
risks.residual_risk: Spreadsheet behaviour varies; tested export format and training remain necessary.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review

risks.title: Unverified regulatory or contract fit
risks.cause: A plan is treated as proof of privacy/compliance or permission to use vendor data.
risks.planned_mitigation: Qualified owner/adviser review of actual obligations, purposes, agreements, retention and processors before activation.
risks.residual_risk: The blueprint is not a compliance certification or legal determination.
risks.residual_rating: Unverified until control evidence and accountable-owner review
